upstream.source_authority: exact typed upstream identities, clocks, lifecycle and frozen geometry only

prohibited_inputs: PnL, MFE, MAE or action labels
swing progression used as path order
support/resistance reaccepted used as an entry trigger
a duplicate Group5 pool reclaim/hold state when Group4 already owns manipulation reacceptance
forming or broken dealing-range midpoint used as value
legacy dealing range or 4H range position used as value

direct mature-range or range-boundary-manipulation registration inside Group5; those remain Group4 and Brain context while Group5 observes only qualified FVG/OB entry locations and their ordered 1m path

parameter_basis.threshold_origin: one-time outcome-blind descriptive engineering choices; no value is selected from PnL, future delivery, action labels, MFE or MAE
parameter_basis.m1_atr_period: fourteen matches the frozen observer scale and is used only for descriptive distance and reaction normalization
parameter_basis.later_hold_bars: one additional real completed 1m bar after the reclaim bar is the minimum observable persistence; the reclaim bar cannot prove that it held itself
parameter_basis.retention_limits: memory-safety limits only; live state is never evicted and no limit authorizes a trade
parameter_basis.path_step_limit: sixteen exceeds every preregistered milestone in either context without retaining an unbounded event log

causal_atr.source: the positive finite value passed from frames[M1].metrics["atr"] on the current completed observation
causal_atr.upstream_definition: scan backward over real_completed M1 candles until at most fourteen finite true ranges are collected; TR=max(high-low, abs(high-prior_real_close), abs(low-prior_real_close)); the first real candle without a prior real close uses high-low; zero TR values remain in the fourteen-value window but the returned mean uses positive values only; synthetic candles are excluded; return 1.0 only when there is no real candle or no positive finite TR
causal_atr.group5_validation: the reducer rejects a passed ATR that is non-finite or not strictly positive
causal_atr.role: descriptive distance normalization only; it is not an entry threshold

clock.decision_update: one reducer call for every newly completed 1m bar
clock.semantic_clock: only real_completed 1m candles can form a location visit, update reacceptance, bind micro BOS, age state or append a path step
clock.knowledge_time: each event clock is the completed-bar end when its full evidence first became knowable and is never backfilled to an intrabar extreme
clock.source_registration: a new open FVG or created order block is registered only on the real completed 1m bar whose end equals source.confirmed_at, after that bar has been processed for older states; partial and untested are continuation states only
clock.source_visit_gate: a registered zone can be visited only by a later real completed 1m bar, so source.confirmed_at <= current_bar.start
clock.cold_start: a zone first seen after its confirmation clock is ineligible because the reducer cannot prove that an earlier first visit did not occur
clock.pool_registration: a pool_reversal context is registered only when a formed_liquidity_pool manipulation is first received as live swept with swept_at equal to current_bar.end; Group4 alone owns reentry and hold, then Group5 binds the root, direction, displacement identity and displacement active clock when the first strictly later aligned displacement-linked FVG/OB makes that displacement causally visible; the context step never freezes that zone identity, later zones from the same displacement remain independent EntryLocation states, and terminal or causal steps cannot be backfilled
clock.synthetic: synthetic or partially synthetic candles may advance raw cutoff but cannot alter semantic state, age, hold count, strength or steps
clock.same_clock: steps derived from one completed candle retain explicit same_clock_known or same_clock_unknown relation; unavailable intrabar ordering is never invented
clock.boundary_identity: censored states retain the old epoch symbol and instrument_id; for contract_change_reset that pair must differ from the boundary observation pair, while data_gap_reset, data_anomaly and tick_size_mismatch require the same pair
clock.exact_retry: an identical retry returns the exact committed update; a non-identical input at the same clock is rejected before mutation
clock.out_of_order: a clock earlier than the last committed clock is rejected before mutation

pool_reversal_context.opposite_displacement_identity: the immutable manipulation/root ID, reverse displacement ID, displacement active clock and context direction; no FVG or order-block ID belongs to this context milestone
pool_reversal_context.knowledge_clock: opposite_displacement.observed_at is the completed-bar clock at which an eligible linked zone first made the displacement visible; source_active_at separately preserves the earlier-or-equal displacement active clock and may never exceed observed_at
pool_reversal_context.child_locations: every later qualifying FVG/OB with the exact frozen displacement identity remains a separate EntryLocation and zone_return path; Group5 does not rank or select among them
pool_reversal_context.optional_opposed_mss: an accepted OPPOSED MSS remains supporting evidence for the already observed reverse displacement and is not a new entry context or substitute zone

entry_location.identity: one location per exact frozen FVG or order-block source; overlapping sources remain separate and expose their common displacement ID

frozen_geometry.near_edge: upper_bound for long and lower_bound for short
frozen_geometry.far_edge: lower_bound for long and upper_bound for short
frozen_geometry.entry_reference: near_edge and midpoint are descriptive price references available to the brain; the eye does not select a planned entry

departure.long: a real completed close strictly above near_edge
departure.short: a real completed close strictly below near_edge
departure.first_clock: the first qualifying completed close at or after source registration
departure.visit_order: departure_confirmed_at must be strictly earlier than first_entered_at

first_pullback.definition: the first later real completed 1m candle whose inclusive high-low range intersects the exact frozen zone after departure is confirmed
first_pullback.near_edge_equality: touching the near edge counts as entering
first_pullback.entry_mode: crossed_near_edge when the bar opens on the delivery side; gap_opened_inside when it opens within the frozen bounds
first_pullback.gap_through: an open strictly beyond the far edge after a prior delivery-side close is left with reason gap_through_frozen_zone and does not invent a first pullback
first_pullback.contact_reference_price: near_edge for crossed_near_edge; the completed bar open for gap_opened_inside; this is a reference, not a claim that the exact tick was the first trade
first_pullback.penetration_fraction: long: clamp((upper_bound - max(bar.low, lower_bound)) / zone_width, 0, 1); short: clamp((min(bar.high, upper_bound) - lower_bound) / zone_width, 0, 1)
first_pullback.immutability: first_entered_at, entry_mode, contact_reference_price, frozen bounds and source identity never change
first_pullback.subsequent_visits: later visits are not first pullbacks

rejection.same_bar: a first-pullback bar that closes strictly on the delivery side is rejected; use same_bar_wick_rejection when it opened on the delivery side and gap_inside_recovery when it opened within the zone
rejection.later_bar: when no qualified reacceptance has begun, a later completed close strictly on the delivery side after an in-zone visit is rejection
rejection.strength: absolute completed-close distance beyond near_edge divided by the causal 1m ATR at rejected_at and clipped to [0,1]
rejection.path_milestone: wick or gap recovery rejection appends one nonterminal zone_rejection_observed milestone; the zone_return path remains active for a strictly-later M1 BOS or a real location failure
rejection.not_action: rejected describes the completed pullback reaction and does not authorize entry

left.adverse_close: long close strictly below far_edge or short close strictly above far_edge
left.gap_through: the first observable post-departure bar opens strictly beyond far_edge without an observable zone trade
left.source_failure: FVG invalidated or order block failed; when typed source failure and a price-derived leave share a clock, the typed source-failure reason and source_event_id take precedence
left.mitigation: FVG mitigated or order block mitigated records a source visit but does not by itself delete an already-registered Group5 path
left.immutability: a left state and its reason are terminal and later extrema cannot rewrite the first pullback or failure

current_view.distance_to_zone: zero inside the bounds, otherwise the shortest point distance to either bound
current_view.distance_to_failure: direction-signed distance from current close to the frozen failure boundary
current_view.draw_candidates_long: inventory lifecycle visible, kind swing/equal_highs/equal_lows but not parked range_boundary, side above, confirmed_at no later than the current completed clock and item.price strictly greater than current completed close
current_view.draw_candidates_short: inventory lifecycle visible, kind swing/equal_highs/equal_lows but not parked range_boundary, side below, confirmed_at no later than the current completed clock and item.price strictly less than current completed close
current_view.draw_distance: absolute item.price minus current completed close
current_view.draw_empty: when no candidate exists, nearest_visible_draw_id and nearest_visible_draw_distance_points are both null
current_view.draws: publish only the first direction-compatible candidate as a bounded descriptive view; the full authoritative inventory remains top-level and this field never selects a target

entry_location.strength_semantics: EntryLocationState has no aggregate strength; first_penetration_fraction and reaction_atr are separate component outputs and each is zero until its defining event occurs

entry_zone_context.anchor: an immutable first pullback to the frozen zone
entry_zone_context.left_long: a completed close strictly below reference
entry_zone_context.left_short: a completed close strictly above reference
entry_zone_context.wick_only: a range touch whose close remains on the delivery side is rejection and creates no reacceptance

reclaim.long: a later real completed close strictly above reference
reclaim.short: a later real completed close strictly below reference
reclaim.same_bar: the leave bar cannot reclaim itself

hold.definition: after reclaim, at least one later real completed 1m close remains strictly on the reclaimed side; held appends one nonterminal qualified_reacceptance_held path milestone
hold.reclaim_bar: the reclaim bar contributes zero hold bars
hold.reference_equality_after_reclaim: a later close equal to reference neither adds a hold bar nor fails; lifecycle remains reclaimed
hold.failure: before held, a completed close strictly back to the adverse side, a completed close strictly beyond the frozen failure boundary or typed entry-zone source invalidation/failure produces an immutable reason; wick-only failure-boundary excursions are not this descriptive failure
hold.same_bar_far_failure: a first-pullback bar that closes strictly beyond the far edge records first_pullback then location_left and creates no reacceptance
hold.strength: freeze reclaim_margin_atr using causal ATR at reclaimed_at and hold_margin_atr using causal ATR at held_at; held strength is their clipped minimum

qualified_reacceptance.censoring: a hard epoch boundary moves a live left or reclaimed state to censored at the boundary clock, emits hard_boundary_censored, exposes it once, then clears it with the old epoch; censoring is not failure
qualified_reacceptance.strength_semantics: reclaim_margin_atr, hold_margin_atr and strength are separate descriptive outputs; all are zero until reclaimed, hold_margin_atr and strength remain zero until held

micro_bos.source: exact Group1-2 Timeframe.M1 BreakOfStructureState; no second detector is permitted
micro_bos.anchor: first_entered_at for zone_return and the opposite_displacement path-step clock for pool_reversal
micro_bos.qualified: the first confirmed M1 BOS whose resolved_at is strictly later than anchor_at and whose direction matches the context direction
micro_bos.opposed_first: if the first strictly later confirmed M1 BOS is opposed, record the contradiction and do not rearm the same context from a later BOS
micro_bos.same_clock: each BOS with resolved_at equal to anchor_at appends micro_bos_simultaneous in ascending bos_id order with same_clock_unknown; it is record-only, is never a bound reference for closure, never counts as aligned or opposed and never closes either context
micro_bos.ambiguous: micro_bos_ambiguous applies only when multiple confirmed BOS records share the earliest eligible resolved_at strictly later than anchor_at; preserve each reference, append one step per reference in bos_id order and close the context as contradiction micro_bos_ambiguous_same_clock

path_sequence.ordering: append only actual typed events in knowledge-clock order; equal clocks retain an explicit relation and no aggregate path score is produced
same_bar_priority: advance already-registered location and reacceptance using the current real 1m candle
apply current typed FVG invalidated or order-block failed and Group4 reaccepted or accepted_outside
append first-pullback, rejection, leave, reclaim, hold and failure steps
bind every current-clock eligible confirmed M1 BOS before closure; if failure and BOS share a clock record both as same_clock_unknown and failure determines the closure reason

register current-clock new open FVG, created order block and swept pool contexts without allowing self-visit, resolution or ordered BOS binding; for a new pool only, append current-input anchor-clock BOS immediately as sorted record-only micro_bos_simultaneous so no prior-clock step is backfilled later
compact previously exposed terminal contexts only

closure.zone_return: wick/gap recovery rejection and qualified reacceptance held are nonterminal milestones; keep the path active until the first strictly-later M1 BOS aligned or opposed, earliest strictly-later BOS ambiguity, location left, reacceptance failure or typed source failure; same-clock simultaneous BOS never closes
closure.zone_location_on_reacceptance_hold: qualified reacceptance held changes an in_zone location to rejected at held_at with reason qualified_reacceptance_held
closure.zone_location_after_trigger_milestone: a rejected location remains frozen but is still monitored; a later completed close beyond far_edge or typed FVG/OB failure changes it to left and closes the active path; the single-state current location clears rejected_at on that transition while the immutable path step retains the earlier trigger identity and clock
closure.zone_location_on_bos_close: when a strictly-later BOS or BOS ambiguity closes a zone path while location is in_zone, retain and freeze that exact in_zone location in the terminal atomic context; do not relabel it left and do not advance its age, state duration or current view after closure
closure.zone_reacceptance_on_bos_close: if a live left or reclaimed reacceptance exists when BOS closes before hold, terminalize it as failed at the closure clock with reason context_closed_before_hold; retain and freeze the in_zone location
closure.zone_location_on_reacceptance_failure: when reacceptance failure closes a zone path and the same bar did not separately satisfy close_beyond_far_edge or typed source failure, retain and freeze the exact in_zone location in the terminal atomic context; do not relabel it left and do not advance its age, state duration or current view after closure
closure.zone_close_reason_priority: when multiple terminal facts share one completed clock use location_left, then reacceptance_failed, then micro_bos_ambiguous_same_clock, then micro_bos_opposed, then micro_bos_aligned; qualified_reacceptance_held and zone_rejection_observed are active milestone reasons, not close reasons
closure.pool_reversal: Group4 reaccepted appends reacceptance_held; then bind one strictly-later opposite displacement through a displacement-linked FVG or qualified OB; only a strictly-later M1 BOS may close the path. Multiple displacement identities on one earliest clock close as opposite_displacement_ambiguous_same_clock. accepted_outside or Group4 resolution deadline closes immediately; same-clock BOS never closes
closure.mitigation: FVG or order-block mitigated alone never closes a continuously registered context
closure.hard_boundary: censor the active path and any live reacceptance rather than claim market failure; expose dedicated censored transitions once, then clear the old epoch
closure.no_active_reacceptance_after_close: a closed or censored path cannot retain a nonterminal reacceptance

path_sequence.not_swing_progression: a scalar swing progression change never appends a path step
path_sequence.strength_semantics: PathSequenceState has no aggregate strength; every PathSequenceStep retains only its own descriptive strength

identity_and_output.canonical_identity_encoding: UTF-8 strings joined by the literal vertical bar in the listed order; timestamps use timezone-aware ISO-8601; IDs are lowercase SHA-256 hex
identity_and_output.reacceptance_id: sha256(group5-reacceptance-v1|protocol_hash|entry_zone|context_id|reference_price_decimal_10|left_at), where reference_price_decimal_10 is the finite positive frozen descriptive reference formatted with exactly 10 decimal places and may be off the executable tick grid

step_source_mapping.location_left: source_event_id=typed source_zone_id only for typed FVG invalidation or OB failure, otherwise null; source_entity_id=location_id
step_source_mapping.opposite_displacement_ambiguous: source_event_id=null; source_entity_id=deterministic identity over competing displacement ids

identity_and_output.step_predecessor: the first step has an empty predecessor_step_ids tuple; every later step contains exactly the immediately prior step_id and no other predecessor

step_relation.strictly_after: observed_at is later than the immediate predecessor
step_relation.same_clock_known: the contract processing priority proves order although both steps share a completed clock
step_relation.same_clock_unknown: both steps share a completed clock and their intrabar order is unavailable

identity_and_output.age: age_real_1m_bars increments once on each later real completed 1m update while the state remains retained and freezes at terminal
identity_and_output.duration: state_duration_real_1m_bars is zero at a lifecycle transition, increments on each later real completed update in that lifecycle and freezes at the next transition
location_required_output: symbol, instrument_id, direction and exact frozen geometry
lifecycle, formed_at, state_started_at, last_updated_at, age and state duration
departure, first entry, entry mode, contact reference, penetration, rejection and left clocks
current price, zone/failure distance, nearest visible draw view
first_penetration_fraction, reaction_atr and exact transition reason; no aggregate strength
reacceptance_required_output: identity, context, source, direction, reference and failure boundary
lifecycle, formed/left/source-reaccepted/reclaimed/held/failed/censored clocks, last update, age and state duration
frozen reclaim margin, hold margin, strength and exact transition reason
path_required_output: lifecycle, formed/state-started/last-updated/ended clocks, age and state duration
complete bounded ordered steps and exact transition reason

step_strength.departure_confirmed: zero; this is a clock predicate
step_strength.reference_left: absolute completed-close margin beyond reference divided by causal ATR, clipped
step_strength.opposite_displacement: zero; displacement measurements remain on the source episode

event_memory.step_events: each newly appended path step is projected with exact path and source identity; the current PathSequenceState retains the complete bounded ordered step tuple
event_memory.hard_boundary: boundary transitions use the dedicated typed observation channel after the prior epoch memory is reset

retention.unit: one context includes its location if any, reacceptance if any, micro BOS references and path
retention.eviction: only a closed or censored context that was exposed in at least one prior successful observation may be evicted; order by earliest ended_at then sequence_id
retention.same_bar_terminal: a context terminalized on the current bar remains visible in that successful output and is not eligible for same-bar eviction
retention.capacity_failure: if a new context requires capacity and no previously exposed terminal context exists, reject the entire update before commit

required: one unified synthetic and boundary suite
one finite real OHLCV descriptive replay
stable state, clocks, duration, strength and invalidation reason consumable by EventMemory, brain and visualization
stopping_rule.repair_limit: at most one concept-level repair; a second systematic semantic failure parks the affected concept
